en.headline: National Security Department arrests 34-year-old man over seditious book imports
en.dek: Police detained a local company director in Mong Kok on Thursday on suspicion of importing publications with seditious intention under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance.
body: The Police Force’s National Security Department arrested a 34-year-old local man in Mong Kok on Thursday on suspicion of importing a publication that has a seditious intention, contravening the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance.

Investigations showed the man, a director of a local company, was suspected of importing seditious books into local bookstores in October with the intent to bring hatred, contempt or disaffection against the Central People’s Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Under court warrants, officers searched the arrested person’s residence and company. Digital devices used to purchase the books, documents and other seditious books were seized. The man is being detained for further enquiries.

Police said importing a publication with seditious intention is a serious offence and that offenders are liable to imprisonment for seven years upon conviction. They urged the public not to defy the law.

zh.headline: 國安處旺角拘捕34歲男子 涉輸入煽動書籍
zh.dek: 警方周四在旺角拘捕一名本地公司董事，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》輸入具煽動意圖的刊物。
body: 警務處國家安全處周四在旺角區採取執法行動，拘捕一名34歲本地男子，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第24條「輸入具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。
警方調查顯示，該名被捕男子為一間本地公司董事，涉嫌於10月輸入煽動書籍到本地書店出售，意圖引起公眾對中央人民政府及香港特別行政區的憎恨、藐視或離叛情緒。
警方根據法庭手令，搜查該名被捕人的住所及公司，檢獲用作購入煽動書籍的數碼裝置、文件及其他煽動書籍。該名男子現正被扣留調查。
警方重申輸入具煽動意圖的刊物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪可被判處監禁七年，並呼籲市民不要以身試法。
